svg.title: Reference pixels fit a transformation and classifier reused at application
svg.desc: Selected image-channel intensities and reference polygons supply a training-resolution label mask. Reference pixels carry the class of their annotation. Each retained pixel produces one feature row in channel order and one native integer label, with zero assigned to illustrative class A and one to class B. The optional row limit selects shuffled rows before feature preprocessing is fitted. The selected rows fit mean/variance normalization and optional PCA, then their prepared values and labels fit the native classifier. Partial random-forest trees and a schematic majority vote show the RF route; two classes separated by a boundary and dashed margins show the SVM alternative. Both use the same extracted and prepared features. Application reuses the saved transformation and classifier at the retained physical sampling resolution and channel order, producing explicit class indices inside the analysis domain. A separate inset shows tissue annotated for the named compartment and tissue explicitly annotated as Ignore. Geometry, intensities, matrix entries, tree structure and map are schematic; no held-out evaluation or measured fit is shown.
